notes.title: 3rd Anniversary of Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea!
notes.content:
Today marks the 3rd anniversary of Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea! 3 years ago today it released after a short few months of development.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/ab7c0384987f1516554c9f6cce53309b23b958eb.png

The original concept was simple—an unlikely duo travel the Victorian countryside and towns searching for a cure to vampirism. The story expanded into the 26k adventure it is today, focused on the four main characters Nemo, Cecil, Lucie, and Ambrose. Since release, over 4k people have traveled with them across Steam & itchio!

Earlier this year we announced a sequel game, Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon, set around 5 years after the events of the first game, following Lucie as the protagonist in an otome-style mystery with 3 love interests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/b2cecee48fd08d71eec21d9c4e3d90ce8f5275b3.jpg

We've been working on this sequel for months and recently released an updated demo in October. If you're eager to see the main 4 back again as well as a new cast of characters, then give it a try!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon/
[previewyoutube=xCTSYrJJX-g;full][/previewyoutube]

To celebrate the 3rd anniversary, we have some new chibi artwork of Lucie with each of her love interests, illustrated by alte_27!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/d2baed067ebbb1351d91dd184ab66f33d797c80b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/2bb614d71b7a43b8af503fd41bac8cf15d0a3a83.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/26f6fb134b624dd43d00300d414013ffc17db8f9.jpg

Thank you for all of the support for both games!

p.s. all of our merch is 10% off until new years day~

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/a3160639f887ef65638c9459607b1649ca494970.jpg

— Arimia

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea is now released!
🎉🎉🎉

After 4 months of solo development, CWES is now out to the world. What started as a few scribblings in my sketchbook in August is now a fully playable story about a group of 4 people navigating the Victorian era and the aftermath of an unsolved vampire attack from a decade prior.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/b33952d5cc3f5459acabb77aeb0c9899d758ec14.jpg

Treat this more as a tale that you're coming along for the ride for rather than an interactive story, as this is a kinetic novel with no choices. Sit back for 2 hours and follow Cecil and Nemo along their travels.

I hope you'll enjoy the journey.

— Arimia
